description: This PHP class provides string manipulation functions such as CONCATENATE, TEXTJOIN, and REPT for the PhpSpreadsheet library, handling string concatenation, joining, and repeated string generation with error handling and support for array inputs.

classes.name: Concatenate
classes.description: Provides string manipulation functions for concatenation, joining, and repeating strings within the PhpSpreadsheet calculation engine.

methods.name: CONCATENATE
methods.description: Concatenates multiple arguments into a single string, flattening arrays and handling errors.

methods.name: TEXTJOIN
methods.description: Joins multiple arguments into a single string with a delimiter, optionally ignoring empty values, supporting array inputs.

methods.name: builtinREPT
methods.description: Repeats a string a specified number of times, handling errors and array inputs.
